name: Sweet and Sweet
source:
The protagonist, Hirayama Souichi, with no particular ambition in mind, chose a safe choice for his career consultation program and entered a university. However, he couldn't quite grasp what a teacher is supposed to do.

In order to find out, he searched a part-time job as related to teaching. Then, Nogihara Akane, his childhood friend and neighbor, told him that an ojousama, Sakaki Rei, was looking for a private tutor. He then took the job.
While working part-time, the protagonist went to the library to study. There, the protagonist found a girl who was alone and separated from her friends...

[Translated and modified from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=106321&gc=gc]Getchu[/url] and the official website]
translation:
主人公平山宗一胸无大志，在升学咨询时选择了一条稳妥道路，进入大学。然而，他始终无法真正理解教师究竟应该做些什么。

为了寻找答案，他开始物色与教学有关的兼职。邻居兼青梅竹马乃木原茜告诉他，一位名叫榊玲的大小姐正在招聘家庭教师，于是他接下了这份工作。
兼职期间，主人公前往图书馆学习。在那里，他发现一名女孩独自待着，与朋友们分隔开来…

[翻译并改编自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=106321&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]及官方网站]
